detected_fault: Poor battery life and performance on battery power, long delay to wake from sleep, HDR mode toggling itself off and displaying incorrect colors, Random BSODs with no error code
suggested_solution: Install the latest Intel graphics drivers using the Intel Driver Support Assistant
Disable all enhancements in the Intel Graphics Command Center and set a new profile with disabled video playback enhancements
Monitor system logs for BSODs and attempt to capture error codes or crash dumps
